scripts.title: Hospital Admin vs Healthcare Admin — Not the Same Job #Shorts

segments.vo: Hospital administration versus healthcare administration. Same job? No. And hiring managers can tell.
Hospital administration means one facility. Budgets, staffing, throughput.
Healthcare administration means the system. Payers, contracts, population health.
Applying for one with the other's resume is why you're getting screened out.

scripts.title: What Does a Healthcare Administrator Actually Do All Day? #Shorts

segments.vo: What does a healthcare administrator actually do all day?
Not paperwork. Three things: staffing, flow, and money.
Staffing: who's on the floor and are the ratios legal.
Flow: how many patients move through and where they jam.
Money: work RVUs in, labor variance out.
If that sounds like your week, free scorecard at the H C A daily dot com.
